28505-the-third-degree-a-narrative-of-me.title: A Narrative of Metropolitan Life
28505-the-third-degree-a-narrative-of-me.creator: CHARLES KLEIN and ARTHUR HORNBLOW
28505-the-third-degree-a-narrative-of-me.description: A book by CHARLES KLEIN and ARTHUR HORNBLOW. me of day when nature loudly claims her due, when business affairs, no matter how pressing, must be temporarily interrupted so that the human machine may lay in a fresh store of nervous energy.

50662-peeps-at-many-lands-england.title: England
50662-peeps-at-many-lands-england.creator: Unknown
50662-peeps-at-many-lands-england.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. give us little grasp of what London means. And if we go to see for ourselves, we may travel up and down its highways and byways until we are dizzy with the rush of its hurrying crowds, its streams of close-packed vehicles, its rows upon rows of houses, shops, banks, churches, museums, halls, theatres, and begin to think that at last we have seen London.

arxiv-2008-00293.title: The test set for the TransCoder system
arxiv-2008-00293.creator: Ernest Davis
arxiv-2008-00293.description: Abstract The TransCoder system translates source code between Java, C++, and Python 3. The test set that was used to evaluate its quality is missing important features of Java, including the ability to define and use classes and the ability to call user-defined functions other than recursively. Therefore, the accuracy of TransCoder over programs with those features remains unknown.

arxiv-2012-12538.title: On uniform Mazur intersection property
arxiv-2012-12538.creator: Pradipta Bandyopadhyay, Jadav Ganesh, Deepak Gothwal
arxiv-2012-12538.description: Abstract . In this paper, we show that a Banach space X X has the Uniform Mazur Intersection Property (UMIP) if and only if every f ∈ S ⁡ ( X ∗ ) f\in S(X^{*}) is uniformly w*-semidenting point of B ⁡ ( X ∗ ) B(X^{*}) . We also prove analogous results for uniform w*-MIP.

arxiv-2101-05449.title: When is every non central-unit a sum of two nilpotents?
arxiv-2101-05449.creator: Simion Breaz and Yiqiang Zhou
arxiv-2101-05449.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Simion Breaz and Yiqiang Zhou. A ring is said to satisfy the 2 2 -nil-sum property if every non central-unit is the sum of two nilpotents. We prove that a ring satisfies the 2 2 -nil-sum property iff it is either a simple ring with the 2 2 -nil-sum property or a commutative local ring with nil Jacobson radical, and we provide an example of a simple rings with the 2 2 -nil-sum property that is not commutative.

arxiv-2109-11642.title: Bayesian Inference of a Social Graph with Trace Feasibility Guarantees Thanks: This work is funded by the ANR (French National Agency of Research) by the “FairEngine” project under grant ANR-19-CE25-0011.
arxiv-2109-11642.creator: Effrosyni Papanastasiou, Anastasios Giovanidis
arxiv-2109-11642.description: Abstract Network inference is the process of deciding what is the true unknown graph underlying a set of interactions between nodes. There is a vast literature on the subject, but most known methods have an important drawback: the inferred graph is not guaranteed to explain every interaction from the input trace.

arxiv-2304-08184.title: Adjustments with Many Regressors under Covariate-Adaptive Randomizations Thanks: Ke Miao thanks the National Natural Science Foundation of China for financial support under grant number 72103046. Yichong Zhang acknowledges the financial support from the Lee Kong Chian fellowship and the NSFC under t
arxiv-2304-08184.creator: Liang Jiang, Liyao Li, Ke Miao, Yichong Zhang
arxiv-2304-08184.description: Abstract Our paper discovers a new trade-off of using regression adjustments (RAs) in causal inference under covariate-adaptive randomizations (CARs). On one hand, RAs can improve the efficiency of causal estimators by incorporating information from covariates that are not used in the randomization.

arxiv-2305-15864.title: Multipole moments of a charged rotating disc of dust in general relativity
arxiv-2305-15864.creator: David Rumler, Reinhard Meinel
arxiv-2305-15864.description: Abstract The gravitational and electromagnetic multipole moments of the charged rotating disc of dust, which is an axisymmetric, stationary solution of the Einstein-Maxwell equations in terms of a post-Newtonian expansion, are calculated and discussed. It turns out that the individual mass, angular momentum, electric and magnetic moments are ordered in the sense that higher moments have a lower absolute value.

arxiv-2402-15976.title: Increasing stability in the n-dimensional inverse source problem with multi-frequencies
arxiv-2402-15976.creator: Suliang Si
arxiv-2402-15976.description: Abstract In this paper, we show for the first time the increasing stability of the inverse source problem for the n-dimensional Helmholtz equation at multiple wave numbers, which is different from the two-or three-dimensional Helmholtz equation. In addition, we develop a new, unified approach to study increasing stability in any dimension.

arxiv-2404-13903.title: Accelerating Image Generation with Sub-Path Linear Approximation Model
arxiv-2404-13903.creator: Chen Xu †, Tianhui Song †, Weixin Feng, Xubin Li, Tiezheng Ge, Bo Zheng, Limin Wang ∗
arxiv-2404-13903.description: Abstract Diffusion models have significantly advanced the state of the art in image, audio, and video generation tasks. However, their applications in practical scenarios are hindered by slow inference speed. Drawing inspiration from the consistency models, we propose the S ub- P ath L inear A pproximation M odel (SPLAM), which can accelerate diffusion models while maintaining high-quality image generation.

arxiv-2501-15228.title: Improving Retrieval-Augmented Generation through Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2501-15228.creator: Yiqun Chen, Lingyong Yan, Weiwei Sun, Xinyu Ma, Yi Zhang, Shuaiqiang Wang, Dawei Yin, Yiming Yang, Jiaxin Mao
arxiv-2501-15228.description: Abstract Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is widely utilized to incorporate external knowledge into large language models, thereby enhancing factuality and reducing hallucinations in question-answering (QA) tasks. A standard RAG pipeline consists of several components, such as query rewriting, document retrieval, document filtering, and answer generation.

arxiv-2506-17636.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Fine-Detailed Surface Reconstruction in Large-Scale Scene
arxiv-2506-17636.creator: Shihan Chen, Zhaojin Li, Zeyu Chen, Qingsong Yan, Gaoyang Shen, Ran Duan
arxiv-2506-17636.description: Abstract Recent developments in 3D Gaussian Splatting have made significant advances in surface reconstruction. However, scaling these methods to large-scale scenes remains challenging due to high computational demands and the complex dynamic appearances typical of outdoor environments. These challenges hinder the application in aerial surveying and autonomous driving.

arxiv-2507-23696.title: On the continuity of derivations over locally regular Banach algebras
arxiv-2507-23696.creator: Felipe I. Flores
arxiv-2507-23696.description: Abstract We study the problem of continuity of derivations over Banach algebras. More specifically, we consider a class of Banach algebras that contain a dense ‘ C ∗ C^{*} -like’ subalgebra. We discuss applications to L p L^{p} -crossed products and symmetrized L p L^{p} -crossed products.

arxiv-2511-18596.title: Dual thermal pseudocritical features in a spin-1/2 Ising chain with twin-diamond geometry
arxiv-2511-18596.creator: Onofre Rojas
arxiv-2511-18596.description: Abstract We study the coupled twin-diamond chain, a decorated one-dimensional Ising model motivated by the magnetic structure of Cu 2 ​ ( TeO 3 ) 2 ​ Br 2 \mathrm{Cu}_{2}(\mathrm{TeO}_{3})_{2}\mathrm{Br}_{2} . By applying an exact mapping to an effective Ising chain, we obtain the full thermodynamic description of the system through a compact transfer-matrix formulation.

europmc-pmc3530470.creator: Soubannier V, Rippstein P, Kaufman BA, Shoubridge EA, McBride HM.
europmc-pmc3530470.description: The mechanisms that ensure the removal of damaged mitochondrial proteins and lipids are critical for the health of the cell, and errors in these pathways are implicated in numerous degenerative diseases. We recently uncovered a new pathway for the selective removal of proteins...

pmc-11590834.title: Evaluating the feasibility and attitudes towards SARS-CoV-2 self-testing in a rural population in Zimbabwe: a cross-sectional survey
pmc-11590834.creator: Lorraine Tsitsi Pfavayi, Emilia Choto, Paradzayi Tagwireyi, Takafira Mduluza, Francisca Mutapi
pmc-11590834.description: ObjectivesThe widespread adoption of self-testing for SARS-CoV-2 has proven effective in curbing the virus’ spread, particularly in Western countries. However, significant knowledge gaps persist regarding the feasibility, acceptance and factors influencing the uptake of self-testing in low-resource areas, notably rural Africa.

pmc-11605886.title: The effectiveness of multicomponent exercise in older adults with cognitive frailty: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11605886.creator: Huanhuan Luo, Zitian Zheng, Zhe Yuan, Huixiu Hu, Chao Sun
pmc-11605886.description: BackgroundCognitive frailty, intimately tied to adverse outcomes such as falls, early mortality, and hospitalization, represents a dynamic, reversible process. Multicomponent exercise has emerged as one of the most potent means of mitigating cognitive frailty.AimsThis research seeks to quantitively amalgamate the effects of multicomponent exercise on various domains: cognitive function, frailty status, and other health-related outcomes in cognitively frail older adults.

pmc-12412238.title: Comparison of triglyceride-glucose index and atherogenic index of plasma in euthyroid Hashimoto’s thyroiditis patients and healthy controls
pmc-12412238.creator: Semra Özkan, Mustafa Harı
pmc-12412238.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). AimThe relationship between insulin resistance and atherosclerosis in euthyroid Hashimoto’s thyroiditis (HT) remains unclear. This study aimed to compare the atherogenic index of plasma (AIP) and triglyceride–glucose (TyG) index between patients with euthyroid HT and healthy controls.Materials and methodsThis retrospective cross-sectional study examined 1,000 patients aged 18–50 who visited the internal medicine outpatient clinic at Mersin City Training and Research Hospital between January 1, 2020, and June 1, 2022.

pmc-12473796.title: Validation of a Newly Developed Assessment Tool for Point-of-Care Ultrasound of the Thorax in Healthy Volunteers (VALPOCUS)
pmc-12473796.creator: Patrick Hoffmann, Tobias Hüppe, Nicolas Poncelet, Julius J. Weise, Ulrich Berwanger, David Conrad
pmc-12473796.description: Objectives: Point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) has become an integral part of emergency, intensive care, and perioperative medicine. However, the training and subsequent evaluation of POCUS users are still not standardized. The aim of the study was to develop and validate an assessment tool for POCUS users.

pmc-12526847.title: A Systematic Literature Review on the Implementation and Challenges of Zero Trust Architecture Across Domains
pmc-12526847.creator: Sadaf Mushtaq, Muhammad Mohsin, Muhammad Mujahid Mushtaq, Rafael Asorey-Cacheda, Nikolaos Pitropakis
pmc-12526847.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) model has emerged as a foundational cybersecurity paradigm that eliminates implicit trust and enforces continuous verification across users, devices, and networks. This study presents a systematic literature review of 74 peer-reviewed articles published between 2016 and 2025, spanning domains such as cloud computing (24 studies), Internet of Things (11), healthcare (7), enterprise and remote work systems (6), industrial and supply chain networks (5), mobile networks (5), artificial intelligence and machine learning (5), blockchain (4), big data and

pmc-12694111.title: Prognostic Value of Resting Energy Expenditure Measured by Indirect Calorimetry in Patients with Cirrhosis Referred for Liver Transplantation †
pmc-12694111.creator: Natalie L. Y. Ngu, Georgia Knapp, Helen Vidot, Joanne Craik, Rachael Jacob, Simone I. Strasser, Geoffrey W. McCaughan, Ken Liu
pmc-12694111.description: Background: Malnutrition is common in cirrhosis but is challenging to identify, grade, and manage during liver transplantation (LT) assessment. The resting energy expenditure informs nutritional needs and can be measured with indirect calorimetry (IC); however, it is not routinely used in this context.

pmc-13086425.title: Generation of a HiBiT-expressing recombinant rat hepacivirus supporting both in vivo and in vitro infection
pmc-13086425.creator: Yasunori Akaike, Tomohisa Tanaka, Hirotake Kasai, Atsuya Yamashita, Yoshiharu Matsuura, Kohji Moriishi
pmc-13086425.description: The lack of immuno-competent animal models of hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection has been an obstacle to vaccine development and research on immune responses. Hepacivirus ratti (Norway rat hepacivirus-1: NRHV1) is a virus closely related to HCV that specifically infects the liver and induces hepatocellular carcinoma in rats, making it a promising surrogate model for HCV.

pmc-13161960.title: Idiopathic Congenital Dislocation of the Knee: Case Series of Spontaneous Reduction
pmc-13161960.creator: Nabil Alassaf
pmc-13161960.description: Introduction:Idiopathic congenital dislocation of the knee (CDK) represents a distinct clinical category. Grade III CDK, defined as knee flexion <30° has a poor prognosis. The standard of care is “as soon as possible” manipulation and casting. Waiting for spontaneous reduction is not regarded as an accepted treatment strategy.

pmc-13400881.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). pmc-13479896.title: Glycolytic cancer-associated fibroblasts orchestrate metabolic remodeling in the tumor microenvironment
pmc-13479896.creator: Xinyu Cui, Akshaya Poonepalle, Chloe Shay, Yong Teng
pmc-13479896.description: Cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) are key regulators of the tumor microenvironment and are predominantly classified according to transcriptional identity. However, this framework overlooks an important dimension of CAF biology, metabolic heterogeneity, which remains insufficiently characterized and is not incorporated into current classification systems.

pmc-13520840.title: Effects of carnosic acid on renal injury-related parameters and iNOS immunoreactivity in an experimental model of contrast-associated acute kidney injury
pmc-13520840.creator: Nejmi Küçükyağcı, Ömer Salt, Mustafa Burak Sayhan, Nurettin Aydoğdu, Ebru Taştekin, Eray Çeliktürk, Esin Seçgin Sayhan
pmc-13520840.description: Contrast-associated acute kidney injury (CA-AKI) remains a clinically relevant complication of iodinated contrast exposure. Carnosic acid possesses antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, but its effects on renal biochemical injury, tubular damage, and inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS) immunoreactivity in CA-AKI remain unclear. This study evaluated carnosic acid in an experimental rat model of CA-AKI.

pmc-13593576.title: Strengthening Clinical Epidemiology in Somalia: Challenges, Opportunities, and Future Directions
pmc-13593576.creator: Ibrahim Abubakar Abdi
pmc-13593576.description: Clinical epidemiology constitutes a foundational pillar of evidence-based medicine and health system strengthening. This commentary examines the current state of clinical epidemiology in Somalia and is intended to stimulate scholarly dialogue and policy action among Somali and international health stakeholders, situating the discussion within the country’s broader trajectory of health system recovery and evidence-based decision-making.
